case.title: Bitcoin Solo Miner Development
case.summary: Desktop Bitcoin mining, made easier to understand. Product development and communication for solo-mining hardware, with StarMiner as a selected client.
case.role: I am one of the developers of Bitcoin solo-miner products. This case brings together the hardware story and the content created around it.
case.scope: Product films, clear explanations of Bitcoin mining, setup guides and material for buyers and dealers. Bitaxe Gamma 601 is featured where relevant.
case.results: A complete video library with individual watch pages, original subtitles and delivery files, organized for quick client review and public discovery.
case.historical: Earlier editions are preserved as produced. Specifications, prices and rewards may change.
case.caveat: Solo mining does not guarantee rewards. StarMiner is a selected client; product and partnership credits remain in the original videos.
